artworks.title: Satyr's Family
artworks.dimensions: sheet (trimmed to plate mark): 8.4 x 7.9 cm (3 5/16 x 3 1/8 in.)
artworks.description: The scene shows a faun-like figure playing a stringed instrument next to a woman who is holding a small child. The faun has goat-like legs, cloven hooves, a human torso, sharp facial features, a beard, and small horns. He has curly hair. The woman has soft features and wears a head wrap. She is reclined on a grassy mound, holding the child close to her chest. The background is simple with sketched lines indicating a natural setting and sparse vegetation. A caduceus symbol is drawn in the top right corner.

artworks.title: Apollo and Diana
artworks.dimensions: sheet (trimmed to plate mark): 16 x 10 cm (6 5/16 x 3 15/16 in.)
artworks.description: The image depicts a nude male figure standing on a curved, lined surface in a dynamic pose. The man is aiming a bow with one foot forward and the other slightly lifted. He has long hair, one arm extended forward, and the other pulling back the bowstring with an arrow near his cheek. The figure wears a quiver of arrows on his back. In the background, there are linear rays, an intricate symbol near his head, and various incised lines.

artworks.title: Two Philosophers
artworks.dimensions: sheet (trimmed to plate mark): 12.9 x 11.1 cm (5 1/16 x 4 3/8 in.)
artworks.description: The image shows two men in a scholarly setting. The man on the left is depicted from the waist up, sitting upright. He has a long, curly beard and wavy hair. He is dressed in a draped robe, and his right arm is resting on a desk with an open book. The man on the right is shown in a reclined position with only his head and upper body visible above a structure. He has a shorter beard and curly hair, and is also wearing a draped garment. The background is simple, with a wall on one side and a symbol resembling a caduceus above them.

artworks.title: Custodi Nos Dormientes (The Guardian Angel)
artworks.dimensions: sheet (trimmed to plate mark): 22.5 x 15.9 cm (8 7/8 x 6 1/4 in.)

artworks.title: Holy Family
artworks.description: The image depicts the upper bodies of three individuals in a drawing or etching. The central figure is seated, looking slightly downward and to the side, with her body angled to the left. She has long wavy hair and gentle facial features. She is draped in flowing, layered clothing and seated on an intricately designed seat. To her left is a child, with curly hair, who is supported by her arm. The child gazes outward with a curious expression. To the right of the central figure, an older man is partially visible, looking toward the woman. He has a long beard and wears a similarly textured robe. There are no visible pieces of jewelry or objects held by the individuals. In the background, the illustration is plain, with an insignia resembling a caduceus positioned near the upper left corner of the image.

artworks.title: Judith Holding the Head of Holofernes
artworks.description: The image depicts a woman standing, holding a sword in her right hand, and gripping an older man's head with a beard in her left hand. She has long hair in a braid, wearing a flowing robe that covers her body and head. The woman's eyes are partially closed, with a serene expression. The setting is plain, with just the figures visible.

artworks.title: Caliope (Calliope)
artworks.description: The image shows a person playing a double recorder. The individual's head is tilted slightly, and they are standing with their left leg extended forward and the right leg pulled back. The person has a calm expression and long hair flowing over their shoulders and down their back. They are dressed in a flowing garment, exposing the left shoulder and extending to their bare feet. In the background, there is a landscape with a distant castle-like structure on the left and rocky formations on the right. Next to the person, there is an ornate fountain with flowing water. The scene is enclosed within a decorative border.

artworks.title: Iupiter (Jupiter)
artworks.description: The image is a full-body illustration of a bearded, crowned man seated within an almond-shaped frame. The man holds a scepter in his right hand and rests his left hand on his knee. He has a long beard, long hair flowing beneath the crown, and wears a flowing robe. Above him, an eagle is perched on the almond shape. Surrounding him are smaller figures in armor. In the background, there are rolling hills and distant structures. The border is simple, and the inscription "IVPITER XXXVI" is visible below.

artworks.title: Chronico (Genius of Time)
artworks.description: The image features a figure standing with one leg slightly bent and barefoot. The person is holding a horned, dragon-like object in their right hand. The figure has curly, shoulder-length hair and a serene facial expression, wearing a flowing, draped garment tied at the waist. The individual has wings extending from their back. The background shows stylized trees and a textured ground, enclosed within a bordered frame.

artworks.title: Council of High Priests
artworks.description: Three individuals are depicted in the image. The first person, on the left, is standing wearing a red tunic, blue tights, brown boots, and a red hat. They have a sword hanging at their side. The middle person, seated in the center, is dressed in a blue robe with white drapery, and a significant headpiece. The third person, seated on the right, is dressed in a red and yellow robe and a pointed hat. The background shows a wooden wall with a green draped curtain and a checkered floor pattern.

artworks.title: Mocking of Christ
artworks.description: The image shows several individuals around a seated figure. The central figure has a beard, long dark hair, and wears a robe, partially covered with a blindfold. Surrounding him are four other figures, each with varying expressions and gestures. One figure is standing behind the seated person and seems to be holding a stick or cane. The others wear hats or headgear, with two appearing to be gesturing toward the seated figure. The clothing is of a medieval or classical style, with tunics and long garments. The background has a simple color pattern of beige and blue, suggesting an outdoor setting against a cloudy sky.

artworks.title: Forteza (Fortitude)
artworks.description: The image shows a full-body illustration of a figure standing in a classical pose, with one arm holding a column. The figure appears to be female, in profile, with long, wavy hair, and a lion-skin headdress. She is draped in a flowing garment with patterned designs and holds a scepter. A lion stands beside her. The background features a simple border frame, and there is an inscription that reads "FORTEZA XXXVI" framed at the bottom.

artworks.title: Iliaco (Genius of the Sun)
artworks.description: The image shows a standing figure with wings on their back, holding a circular object with a face. The person is facing sideways, with their left arm extended outward. They have a straight nose, prominent lips, and curly hair. The figure is wearing a draped garment tied at the waist and is barefoot. The background includes a simple patterned border, with grass-like details at the bottom.

artworks.title: Melpomene
artworks.description: The image shows a person standing in a natural setting, blowing into a horn. The person has long, wavy hair, detailed facial features, and is dressed in a flowing garment with a belt around the waist. They are barefoot and playing a musical instrument. Surrounding them are rolling hills, distant structures, and stylized grass. A large circle is to the right of their feet, and the scene is framed by a border.

artworks.title: Justicia (Justice)
artworks.description: The image shows a person standing upright. The person is positioned facing forward, holding a sword in their right hand and a set of scales in their left hand. The individual's facial features include distinctive eyes and wavy hair cascading down their shoulders. They are dressed in a flowing robe, secured with a circular brooch. Surrounding the figure is a simple background with minimal detail, and a bird is standing on one leg at the person's left foot. The frame of the image contains decorative elements, and at the bottom, there is text that reads "IVSTICIA XXXVII."

artworks.title: Octava Spera (Eighth Sphere)
artworks.description: The image shows a winged figure standing in a full-body pose. The figure's head is turned slightly upward to the left with a serene expression, delicate facial features, wavy hair, and shoulder-length attire. Large feathered wings extend from the figure's back. The figure holds a circular object with a star pattern. An inscription "OCTAVA SPERAXXXVIII 48" is featured at the bottom of the canvas. The background is plain.

artworks.title: Prudencia (Prudence)
artworks.description: This is a drawing of an allegorical figure holding a mirror supported by a winged child on a pedestal. The figure is shown in profile, draped in long, flowing robes with intricate folds. The figure holds a mirror in which a winged child is reflected. At the feet of the figure, there is a small dragon with a curled tail, open mouth, and wings. The composition is contained within a decorative border, and the bottom panel contains markings that read "PRVDENCIA XXXV."

artworks.title: Saturno (Saturn)
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a mythological figure holding an infant and surrounded by seated children. The figure is depicted in traditional attire with draped robes and a long beard. He holds an infant, with a gesture that suggests a narrative involving parental sacrifice or protection. The infant is shown with exaggerated proportions, suspended above a sickle, a symbolic object held in one of the figure's hands. The other hand stabilizes the infant's back. Around the lower part of the figure, four children are seated peacefully. The border of the image contains diagonal lines. The text at the bottom, "A SATVRNO XXXXVII," is present. The drawing contains intricate detailing.

artworks.title: Temperancia (Temperance)
artworks.description: The image shows a woman holding a jug in each hand. She has closed eyes, wavy hair, and is wearing a flowing gown with a draped cloak. A small animal is by her feet. The background is plain with a line indicating the edge of a floor or platform, bordered by a pattern. Inscribed at the bottom are the words "TEMPERANCIA" and Roman numerals.

artworks.title: Old Man Standing under Tree
artworks.description: The image shows a full-length drawing of a person standing. The person is turned slightly to the side, with the head turned towards the left. The individual has a pronounced nose and appears to have older facial features set in a contemplative expression. They are wearing a wide-brimmed hat that partially covers their hair, and the long robes they wear suggest a historical setting. The clothing is layered, with a tunic-like top and a sashed belt. In one hand, the person holds a round object and a sack in the other hand. An earthenware pot or jug is placed on the ground near their feet. The background is minimally detailed, with the year 1520 inscribed and faint lines and shapes giving an impression of a rustic or pastoral environment.

artworks.title: Saint Sebald
artworks.description: The image depicts a bearded man seated beneath two large trees. He is positioned with one leg bent and resting on the ground, using his left hand to steady himself with a staff. His facial features include a thick beard and mustache, and his eyes appear focused. He wears a cap with two crossed keys, a halo of light radiating from his head, and a cloak tied around his shoulders. In his right hand, he holds a miniature architectural model resembling a church. The background includes rolling hills, sparse trees, a small town with castle-like structures, and a bird perched on a tree branch.

artworks.title: Dance of the Gods of Love
artworks.artist: Sebald Beham, after Marcantonio Raimondi, after Raphael
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a group of cherubic figures engaged in a dance in a circular formation. The figures are depicted with a sense of movement, their arms interlinked as they twirl together. Each figure is characterized by curly hair, rounded forms, and wings. The background is textured, suggesting a setting of a natural surface with small stones or a path.

artworks.title: Trajan
artworks.description: The image shows a profile of a person's head and partial neck within a circular laurel wreath. The individual has distinct facial features, including a prominent nose and chin. The hairstyle is tight, wavy locks pulled back, and a laurel wreath crowns the head. The background is plain, with an inscription reading "IMP. CAESAR. TRAIANVS. AVG." Below the portrait are the initials "ISB" and the year "1546". The overall style resembles a classical engraving, featuring detailed line work and traditional iconography.

artworks.title: Domitia Calvilla
artworks.description: The image shows a person in profile view from the shoulders up, facing left. The person has detailed facial features, a prominent nose and chin. Their hair is styled intricately in braids across their head. The person wears a garment fastened at the neck with a circular clasp. They are surrounded by an ornate wreath made of broad leaves. The background is a textured surface. In the upper part of the image, there is text that reads "DOMITIA CALVILLA M ANT IMP MATER," with the year "1546" and the initials "ISB" in opposite corners.
